name: claude-toolz
description: Claude Code plugins for second opinions, security triage, docs upkeep, and pre-commit setup.

plugins.name: ask-llm
plugins.description: Get a second opinion from ChatGPT, Gemini, or DeepSeek via /ask-llm or plain language. Standard-library Python script — no dependencies and no install step.

plugins.name: precommit-detect
plugins.description: Detects whether a repo's pre-commit setup is wired up and walks you through approval-gated installs.

plugins.name: resolve-github-alerts
plugins.description: Resolves GitHub security alerts (Dependabot, code scanning, secret scanning) and opens PRs for review, via /resolve-github-alerts or plain language.

plugins.name: revise-all-docs
plugins.description: Updates and audits CLAUDE.md, README.md, and docs/**/*.md. /revise-all-docs captures session learnings; /improve-all-docs runs a static quality audit.
